fields.description: Over 90%+ of businesses in Nepal are MSMEs, driving economic growth and jobs. With 923K+ establishments (2018), many are based in Koshi Province, including key hubs like Birnagar and Itahari. SMEs contribute 22% to GDP and 70%+ of non-farm employment.
